basic_info.description: Magnificent & Expansive Mediterranean w/ Stunning Panoramic Vistas; the Golden Gate Bridge, the Marin Headlands, the Presidio & around to the Financial District skyline, Lone Mountain & Sutro Tower. Built in 1926 and owned by the same prominent San Francisco family since 1934, it is available to a new owner for the first time in over 80 years. Spacious over-sized living spaces with luscious & original period details; two stained glass windows, one in the foyer and the 2nd above the main staircase, gorgeous redwood paneling & crown moulding, a carved stone FP in the Formal Liv Room & a Redwood and tile FP in the Fam Room. The views from the Family Room & all north-facing windows, are simply sublime. This is a truly spectacular trophy home!!!
